newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia noon rubber mixed on Tokyo's uncertainty.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia noon rubber mixed on Tokyo's uncertainty.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices were were mixed at noon due to uncertainty in Tokyo and lack of strong offtake from consumers, dealers said.
"The market was quiet this morning. Players are concerned over the trend in Tokyo," a dealer said, adding prices are likely to hover at around current levels.
"Prices in Thailand are high but consumers are not coming in after having covered their positions in recent weeks," said the dealer.
The market saw some Europeans covering for latex and SMR grades for nearby positions, they said.

At midday close, Malaysian Rubber Exchange and Licensing Board quoted June RSS Ones buyer at 282 cents ($1.12) a kg , up half a cent from Tuesday's close but June SMR 20 buyer slipped half a cent to 264 cents.
A Malaysia-based shipping agent quoted freight rates for rubber from Malaysia to Rotterdam at $800 per TEU (or 20-ft container), and $1,700 per two-TEU containers (or 40-ft container).
